description: Golden retrieval set for the Northstar AP policy corpus. Each query is one a processing run actually issues, phrased the way a finance analyst would ask it rather than copied from the target section, so the set measures retrieval and not string equality. 'accept' lists every section that answers the query; a hit is any of them.
notes: Hit@3 and MRR are the operative metrics. Hit@1 is reported but is not the gate: the agent consumes a top-k window, not a single chunk, so a target at rank 2 with the authority section also present is a successful retrieval for this architecture.
The two safety assertions are absolute rather than statistical: the distractor must never appear in a policy result, and the current authority matrix must always outrank the superseded one.
